Restored verbatim\n// from a same-session read of the pre-loss content; not re-derived or\n// reinterpreted.\n\nimport { createHash, randomUUID } from \"node:crypto\";\nimport { mkdirSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, renameSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from \"node:fs\";\nimport { dirname, join, resolve } from \"node:path\";\nimport { fileURLToPath } from \"node:url\";\nimport { coordinationReadout, targetCovers } from \"./coordination-readout.mjs\";\n\nconst HERE = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));\nexport const ROOT = resolve(HERE, \"..\");\nexport const WORK_ORDERS_DIR = join(ROOT, \"data/records/work-orders\");\nexport const LOCKS_DIR = join(ROOT, \"data/state/locks\");\n\nexport const SOURCES = Object.freeze([\"registry-watch\", \"leader-speech\", \"manual\"]);\nexport const CLASSES = Object.freeze([\"repair\", \"verify\", \"define\", \"deploy\"]);\nexport const STATUSES = Object.freeze([\"open\", \"awarded\", \"diagnosed\", \"staged\", \"fulfilled\", \"failed\"]);\n// Every status short of terminal: a target with an order anywhere in this\n// set already has live work claiming it.
